title: Snuffling Cat
desc: Cerenia, Cerenia in a nebuliser, Azithromycin tablets, Azithromycin liquid, Famciclovir, Nasal saline flush, Neo-Poly-Dex drops, Chlorpheniramine, Krill oil capsules, Adequan, then oral GAGs, Antioxidant combination, High-protein, gluten-free diet

meds.name: Cerenia
meds.doseText: ¼ to ½ of a 16 mg tablet
freqs: BID for 1–2 days, then SID for 5 days

meds.name: Cerenia in nebulizer
meds.doseText: 2 drops of injectible cerenia added to nebulizer saline

meds.name: Azithromycin
freqs: SID for 5 days, then twice weekly

meds.name: Azithromycin liquid
freqs: SID for 5 days, then every 3 days (or twice weekly) for 6 weeks

meds.name: Famciclovir Antiviral
meds.doseText: 62.5 mg twice daily, or 250 mg once daily

meds.name: NuCat Senior
meds.doseText: Combinations of antioxidants ie NuCat Senior

meds.name: High protein gluten free diet
meds.doseText: High protein gluten free diet... NO DRY FOOD

notes: Cerenia
16 mg tab: 1/4 to 1/2 tab PO
BID 1-2 days, SID another 5 days, then 2 to 4 mg (per cat) twice weekly.
Lester
reduces discharge and inflammation caused by substance P
Cerenia in nebulizer worked very well for Spunky Johnson (started with 2 drops of injectible cerenia added to nebulizer saline once a day, O noted improvement right away)
Azithromycin
Dose = 1/4 of 250 mg tab
SID 5 days, then twice weekly for months (Lester)
Azithromycin liquid (200mg/5ml = 50 mg/ml): 10 mg/kg SID for 5 days, then q 3 days (or twice weekly) for 6 weeks (Folger)
Famciclovir Antiviral: doses all over the map up to 40 mg/kg TID. Generally either 62.5 mg BID or 250 mg SID (depending on consultant) for 6 weeks.
1) 1/4 250 azithromycin tablet daily for 5 days then
2 X weekly...for weeks and months. Works as an
anti inflammatory and anti biofilm.
2) Local therapy....flush with saline ± hypertonic saline (2-3%)
and follow with ophthalmics like Neo-Poly-Dex drops tid
Hold head back so drops run backward....
3) Cerenia..best drug for nasal congestion and to reduce
inflammation cause by much excessive substance P in the area.
Give low dose daily ie 2-4mg or regular EOD.
4) Chlorpheniramine (antihistamine) is also an antidepressant with approx 50% of
anti anxiety effects compared to fluoxetine and still has antihistamine effects
that are synergistic with Cerenia..
5) Krill fish oil caps
6) Adequan follow by oral GAG's to improve cartilage damage and
repair in the sinuses from previous damage from viruses and bacteria etc.
7) Combinations of antioxidants ie NuCat Senior
8) High protein gluten free diet...more pro-inflammatory
effects from high glucose and high carbohydrate diets.
NO DRY FOOD
Lester Mandelker DVM DABVP
Fellow AAVPT
